title: At the Café
text:
Ana is at a café with her friend Maria. Ana says hello to the waiter. The waiter smiles and gives her a menu.

Ana wants a coffee. Maria wants a tea. They say thank you and sit by the window.

questions.text: What does Maria want to drink?
How does the waiter seem to feel?
Why does Ana say thank you?

vocabulary.definition: a small place where you can buy coffee and food
a person who brings food and drinks to your table
a list of food and drinks in a restaurant
an opening in a wall that lets in light and air

paragraph_translations: Ana está en un café con su amiga Maria. Ana saluda al camarero. El camarero sonríe y le da una carta.
Ana quiere un café. Maria quiere un té. Dan las gracias y se sientan junto a la ventana.
